$comment: The declared consumption shape (KTD11), identical in kind to the client package's: compiled
CommonJS plus type declarations. See that file's comment for why package.json declares no
`type` field and why the three module-interop options below are load-bearing.
This package resolves `@entur/smart-avvik-notifications-client` through the npm `file:` link to its
sibling, so it consumes the sibling's BUILT dist -- the same artifact a client gets. That is
why `build:client` runs first in every script that compiles or tests: an unbuilt sibling is a
missing module, not a type error.
